instruction.text: Find Alan Turing in the image.

end.text: Alan Turing was born on 23rd June 1912. He was a famous computer scientist, who helped to crack Nazi codes during the Second World War.
end.sound: Alan Turing was born on 23rd June 1912. He was a famous computer scientist, who helped to crack Nartzee codes during the Second World War.

atoms.b: Alan had quite a lonely childhood because his parents were often away in ((++India Mars)).
He was also sent to ((++boarding driving)) school at the age of 13.

hint.text: On Alan’s first day at Sherborne School, there was a General Strike. This meant that no transport was running but, because Alan was so keen to get to school and learn, he instead rode his bike 60 miles to school!
hint.label: Did you know?

atoms.a: Which two subjects do you think Alan enjoyed the most?
Which two subjects do you think Alan’s school liked the most?

feedback.finish: As his school mainly taught classics, Alan spent a lot of time alone solving complex maths problems and teaching himself advanced science.

atoms.b: Alan then studied ((++maths art)) at the University of Cambridge and even started ((++teaching drawing)) there when he was only ((++22 99)) years old!
In 1936, Alan Turing also went to the University of Princeton in the USA to get another ((++degree award)) called a PhD.
